@@ -1,4 +1,4 @@
-font_family FiraCode NF
+font_family FiraCode Nerd Font
 
 # https://github.com/tonsky/FiraCode/wiki/How-to-enable-stylistic-sets
 #> kitty + list-fonts --psnames | grep Fira
@@ -23,3 +23,12 @@ editor vim
 
 map ctrl+shift+t launch --cwd=current --type=tab
 map ctrl+shift+enter launch --cwd=current
+
+map f1 toggle_marker regex 2 ────*
+map f2 toggle_marker regex 1 err(or)?
+map f3 toggle_marker regex 3 warn(ing)?
+
+
+map ctrl+, scroll_to_mark prev
+map ctrl+. scroll_to_mark next
+
